from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class Paper(BaseModel):
    """A single paper from the provided collection, capturing its title and which other provided papers it references."""
    title: str | None = Field(description="The full title of this paper as it appears in the document")
    references_provided_papers: list[str] = Field(description="Titles of the other provided papers that this paper explicitly references or cites in its bibliography. Leave empty if none match the provided collection.")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    papers: list[Paper]
